claim: "Which manager led Inter Milan to the 2010 Champions League final, beating Bayern Munich?" Inter did not beat Bayern on the way to the final — they beat Barcelona in the semi and met Bayern in the final itself. As written the stem misstates the route; it should read "to the 2010 Champions League title, beating Bayern in the final".
q: Which manager led Inter Milan to the 2010 Champions League final, beating Bayern Munich?

claim: Stem says Kane 'scored 213 Premier League goals for Tottenham between 2011 and 2023'. q: Which player scored 213 Premier League goals for Tottenham between 2011 and 2023 before joining Bayern Munich?

claim: Stem asserts West Ham "holds the unwanted record of being relegated from the Premier League with the highest points total — 42 points in 2002-03". As a raw points total that is false: Crystal Palace were relegated from the Premier League in 1992-93 with 49 points (and Sheffield United went down with 42 in 1993-94, tying it). West Ham's 42 is only the record for the 20-team/38-game era; the stem states it as an unqualified record.
q: Which club holds the unwanted record of being relegated from the Premier League with the highest points total — 42 points in 2002-03?

claim: Stem says Totti wore the number "throughout his entire Roma career". False: when Serie A introduced fixed squad numbers in 1995-96 Totti wore 20, then 17, and only took the No. 10 from 1997. The keyed answer (10) is right; the "entire career" clause is not.
q: Which squad number did Francesco Totti wear at Roma from 1997 until his retirement in 2017?

claim: Stem calls France 1-0 Germany "the Group F opener" at Euro 2020. It was not: Hungary vs Portugal kicked off at 17:00 CET in Budapest on 15 June 2021, three hours before France vs Germany (21:00 CET, Munich). Hungary-Portugal was the Group F opener.
q: Who beat Germany 1-0 in Group F at Euro 2020 (played 2021) thanks to a Mats Hummels own goal — the Group F opener dubbed one of the tournament's Group of Death matches?
